evidence: Home page shows 6 template cards each with title, author (e.g. Sarah Chen), and description text.
Each card shows title, author, description, category badge, scenario badge, usage count (e.g. "1,250 uses"), and update date (e.g. "Updated 2024-12-01").
Clicking Use Template on Professional Resume opened a preview panel with Fill Template/Preview Result tabs and a form listing all 14 fields.
With no fields filled, UI shows "Required fields missing Please fill in: Full Name, Job Title, Email, ..." and Preview Result tab is disabled (click timed out: element not enabled).

All 14 fields of Professional Resume template (Full Name, Job Title, Email, Phone, Summary, Company, Position, Start/End Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills) accepted text input.

After filling all required fields, Preview Result tab became enabled and showed generated text with entered values substituted (e.g. "Timothee Issenmann Software Engineer | timothee@example.com | ...").

actual: Entering "invalid-email" (no @domain format) in the required Email field did not show any validation error and did not block the Preview Result tab; the preview was generated successfully containing the invalid string "invalid-email" verbatim.

issue: Preview available despite invalid (not just nonblank) required field value
actual: Required-field blank check works (preview tab disabled when fields empty), but with all fields nonblank yet Email containing invalid format "invalid-email", preview tab was still enabled and generated a preview - so validity of values is not enforced, only presence.

evidence: Entering "<script>alert(1)</script>" style text with characters < > into the Professional Summary field triggered inline error "Special characters like < > { } [ ] \\ | ` are not allowed" and disabled the Preview Result tab until the offending characters were removed.
Clicking Copy to Clipboard in Preview Result showed toast "Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied."
Clicking the favorite toggle in preview immediately switched its state to "on" and the header Favorites button count updated from no count to "1".

Professional Resume template preview rendered as Markdown: H1 name heading, bold job title, separator line, H2 section headings (Professional Summary, Experience, Education, Skills), bold sub-headings, with all placeholders (name, title, email, summary, company, position, dates, degree, school, year, skills) replaced by entered values.

Category=Resume showed "1 of 6"; Scenario=Academic showed "1 of 6" (Academic Research Summary); Sort=Alphabetical reordered list to Academic, Meeting Minutes, Professional Email, Professional Resume, Project Proposal, Weekly Status Report.
Category, scenario, and sort selections updated result count/order instantly with no page navigation/reload observed (same URL throughout).

Typing "Res" showed a real-time suggestion dropdown (Professional Resume, Responsibilities, In Progress, Academic Research Summary, Research Title). Clicking "Professional Resume" filled the search box and narrowed results to "Showing 1 of 6 templates".

actual: Searching "Resme" (missing letter, one-character-off typo of "Resume") returned "No templates found" / "Showing 0 of 6 templates" and no suggestions appeared, instead of fuzzy-matching to "Professional Resume".

evidence: Added/removed favorites via card toggle; Favorites header count updated (1→2→1); Favorites-only toggle filtered grid to only favorited templates.

While Favorites-only mode active with 2 favorites, searching "Weekly" narrowed to 1 result; applying Category=Resume filter narrowed to 1 result (Professional Resume) - both search and filter work within favorites view.

Submitted custom template "QA Custom Test Template" with title, description, author, category (Other), scenario (Business), Markdown content with {{name}}/{{role}} placeholders, and 2+ defined fields; toast "Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library." appeared.
Immediately after submission, result count changed from "Showing 6 of 6" to "Showing 7 of 7 templates" and the new card appeared in the grid without any page reload/navigation.
Clicking Submit Template on a completely blank form showed toast "Missing required fields - Please fill in all required fields." and did not create a template.

issue: Duplicate field labels not rejected or disambiguated
actual: Adding a second field labeled "Name" (after one already existed) was accepted without error - the field list showed two separate entries both labeled "Name" (one Required, one Optional, both mapped to the same {{name}} placeholder), and the template submitted successfully with this duplicate intact.

evidence: Opened the newly submitted "QA Custom Test Template" via its Use Template button, filled Name/Role fields, and generated a rendered Markdown preview (H1 heading, bold "Role:", separator, paragraph) - confirming it is selectable and usable like a built-in template.

issue: Submission does not validate field↔placeholder mapping; unresolved placeholders reach the preview
actual: Submitted a template with content "Hello {{fullName}}, welcome!" but declared field labeled "Different Field" (key different_field, not matching "fullName"). Submission succeeded with toast "Template submitted!" (no mismatch error). Opening the template and generating its preview produced "Hello {{fullName}}, welcome!" with the placeholder left unresolved/unreplaced.

evidence: Plain-text template ("Plain Text Note", Markdown toggle off) preserved raw text: "# Not a heading Hello Alice, this is ** not bold **." rendered as plain paragraph text, not as heading/bold. Markdown templates (Professional Resume, QA Custom Test Template) rendered actual H1/H2 headings, bold, and separators after substitution.

After navigating to the app URL again (reload), "Showing 9 of 9 templates" still includes the 3 custom submitted templates (Plain Text Note, Mismatch Test Template, QA Custom Test Template), and Favorites count/state remained "1" with Professional Resume still favorited.
